newsitem.title: USA: Revlon, Cosmetic Center to merge stores - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Revlon, Cosmetic Center to merge stores - WSJ.

text.p: Revlon Inc will merge its chain of discount fragrance stores with Cosmetic Center Inc of Savage, Md in a deal that is scheduled to close early next year, the Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.
The newspaper said Revlon would combine its 198 stores called Prestige Fragrance & Cosmetics with Cosmetic Center's 68 stores, which also sell cosmetics and fragrances.

It said Revlon would have a controlling interest in the new company, receiving between 65 percent and 83 percent of new Class C shares of stock. Holders of Cosmetic Center's Class A and B shares would get either one share of the newly issued Class C voting stock or $7.63 in cash for each of their shares.
Cosmetic Center is expected to limit its cash payout to about $21.6 million, it added.
Once the operation is complete, Revlon plans to later sell the new company, the newspaper said.
